record.context_brief: Perturbations of closed operators on Banach spaces
record.original_question: Let S: X → Y and T: Y → Z be closed operators, and let A: X → Y and B: Y → Z be bounded operators. Define S̃ = S + A and T̃ = T + B. It is known in the Hilbert-space case that dim(N(T̃)/R(S̃)) = dim(N(T)/R(S)) < ∞. Does the same estimate hold when X, Y, and Z are Banach spaces?

evidence.quote: Given closed operators S: X→Y, T: Y→Z and bounded operators A: X→Y, B: Y→Z. Let S̃=S+A, T̃=T+B. Known that dim(N(T)/R(S)) = dim(N(T̃)/R(S̃)) < ∞ if X, Y, Z are Hilbert spaces. Does the same estimate hold if X, Y, Z are Banach spaces?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$, $Y$, $Z$ be Banach spaces. Let $S\colon X\to Y$ and $T\colon Y\to Z$ be closed linear operators (each defined on a linear subspace of the domain space, with closed graph in the relevant product space), and let $A\colon X\to Y$ and $B\colon Y\to Z$ be bounded linear operators defined on all of $X$ and $Y$ respectively. Define the perturbed operators
$$\widetilde S = S + A, \qquad \widetilde T = T + B,$$
with the natural domains $\mathrm{dom}(\widetilde S)=\mathrm{dom}(S)$ and $\mathrm{dom}(\widetilde T)=\mathrm{dom}(T)$. Denote by $N(\cdot)$ the null space and by $R(\cdot)$ the range of an operator, and assume that the inclusions $R(S)\subseteq N(T)$ and $R(\widetilde S)\subseteq N(\widetilde T)$ hold, with $\dim\bigl(N(T)/R(S)\bigr)<\infty$.

It is known that when $X$, $Y$, $Z$ are Hilbert spaces, one has
$$\dim\bigl(N(\widetilde T)/R(\widetilde S)\bigr) \;=\; \dim\bigl(N(T)/R(S)\bigr) \;<\;\infty.$$

Question: Does this equality continue to hold when $X$, $Y$, $Z$ are arbitrary Banach spaces?

artifact.status_search_result: A brief web search returned general literature on Fredholm-type stability of indices under bounded/compact perturbations of closed operators on Banach spaces, but did not yield a direct resolution of this specific cohomological-dimension stability question for a pair of closed operators forming a "complex." No definitive solved/open statement was located.

status_evidence.title: Perturbed Operators on Banach Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses stability of Fredholm-type properties of closed operators on Banach spaces under bounded perturbations.
status_evidence.claim: Related stability results exist for Banach-space closed operators, but the specific equality is not explicitly resolved here.

status_evidence.title: On the perturbation theory for Fredholm operators (Akashi)
status_evidence.snippet: Perturbation theory for Fredholm operators on Banach spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Relevant background; does not directly resolve the quotient-dimension question in the Banach setting.
